questions.text: Substitution is the reverse of which derivative rule?
A good choice for $u$ is usually
options: an inside function whose derivative also appears

questions.text: Your final answer to an indefinite integral should be written in terms of $u$.
questions.explain: Put $x$ back in at the end.

questions.text: In a definite integral, after substituting you can either change the limits to $u$-values or go back to $x$ first.
questions.explain: Just do not mix them: $u$-limits go with a $u$-integral.

questions.text: Put the steps of substitution in order.
items: Rewrite the integral in $u$ and integrate
questions.explain: Choose, differentiate, rewrite and integrate, substitute back.

questions.text: What is a good $u$ for $int 6x(3x^2 + 4)^4 dx$?
questions.label: $u$ =
questions.explain: $u = 3x^2 + 4$, because its derivative $6x$ is right there.
